create_SAM2Transforms: create a SAM2Transforms instance with resolution, mask threshold, and hole filling parameters
call_SAM2Transforms: call SAM2Transforms on an image to resize and normalize it for the SAM2 model
forward_batch_SAM2Transforms: transform a batch of images into a stacked tensor using SAM2Transforms forward_batch
transform_coords_SAM2Transforms: transform coordinates to SAM2 model space using transform_coords with optional normalization
postprocess_masks_SAM2Transforms: postprocess SAM2 output masks to fill holes and remove sprinkles with postprocess_masks
